supported_scope: Packaging, sharing, versioning, and invoking reusable skills and task workflows via native SKILL.md format, plugin management, and automatic skill discovery and invocation
unestablished_scope: Invocation rules beyond automatic context-based and explicit name mention
Sharing mechanisms outside plugin installation and workspace/global skill discovery
required_setup: Skills must be defined as folders containing a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter and instructions; skills can be managed via plugins using agy plugin commands; no explicit user invocation needed as agent auto-discovers and activates relevant skills
constraints: Skill files require YAML frontmatter defining name and triggering criteria
Skills should be focused on one task
Skills can include optional scripts and resources
Agent uses progressive disclosure to load skill content on demand
Skill usage is automatic based on context but can be explicitly mentioned by name

evidence.quote: Skills are reusable packages of knowledge that extend what the agent can do. Each skill contains: Instructions, Best practices, Scripts and resources
evidence.claim: Skills are reusable packages that extend agent capabilities with instructions and resources

evidence.section: Agent skills > How the agent uses skills
evidence.quote: When a conversation starts, the agent sees a list of available skills with their names and descriptions. If a skill looks relevant to your task, the agent reads the full SKILL.md content. The agent follows the skill’s instructions while working on your task.
evidence.claim: Agent automatically discovers, activates, and executes skills based on context

evidence.section: Agent skills > Agent skills > Manifest format ( SKILL.md )
evidence.quote: Every SKILL.md file begins with YAML frontmatter defining its name and triggering criteria
evidence.claim: Skills are packaged as folders with SKILL.md files containing YAML frontmatter

evidence.quote: Skills can also be packaged inside plugins and managed with agy plugin : agy plugin install <plugin-name>
evidence.claim: Skills can be shared and installed via plugins using CLI commands
